text: {"findings":[{"resource_address":"azurerm_storage_account.exports","doc_id":"POL-001","attribute":"https_traffic_only_enabled","title":"azurerm_storage_account.exports sets \"https_traffic_only_enabled\" to false and \"min_tls_version\" to \"TLS1_0\", which breaks the storage account hardening requirement for encrypted transport and TLS 1.2.","suggestion":"Set https_traffic_only_enabled to true and min_tls_version to TLS1_2.","breaks_standard":true}]}
